xfail.invariant:accepted_needs_person: AI-first Stage 2: one author. Nothing is pre-accepted by the rules; the person's yes or the single approval records every decision.
xfail.invariant:same_plan_without_ai: AI-first Stage 2: the default author turns the fact tools' suggestion (turn the month columns into rows) into the same plan when no AI is connected.
xfail.unpivot#plan_runs: AI-first Stage 4: one guard layer. The unpivot the Doctor offers must be a step the goal's helper may run (customer-spend's may not, so its own offer stops the plan).
xfail.approved: AI-first Stage 4: one guard layer. The unpivot the Doctor offers must be a step the goal's helper may run, so the plan can be approved.
xfail.final: AI-first Stage 4: one guard layer. The unpivot the Doctor offers must be a step the goal's helper may run, so the plan can be approved.
